evaluation.summary: Accurate, well-structured one-page CV that uses the CV, portfolio and notes faithfully: FIFO, HACCP temperature checks, the fair award and the planned master exam are all presented truthfully, with no supermarket or forklift experience invented. The main weakness is that the 9 years of experience is never stated as a figure, and the pallet-jack experience, forklift-course willingness and shift readiness from the notes are left out. The cover letter is targeted to FreshCart's honest-advice value and explains the move well, but is a fairly flat CV recap. Layout and ATS text are clean.
